name: The Laurus, Singapore
positioning: The Laurus, a Luxury Collection Resort, Singapore: a resort on Sentosa Island within Resorts World Sentosa, designed like a well-travelled collector's home with Peranakan and colonial interiors
best_for: Travelers who want a calm, art-filled base steps from Universal Studios Singapore and Singapore Oceanarium
Guests who value heritage-inspired design, spa time and a pool framed by greenery

facts.text: The Laurus is on Sentosa Island, 25 minutes from Changi Airport and 10 minutes from the CBD.
A stay at The Laurus extends into the wider Resorts World Sentosa destination.
Singapore Oceanarium and Universal Studios Singapore are just steps away.
The resort draws inspiration from a well-travelled collector's home, bringing together art, objects and textures from diverse eras and cultures.
Each suite is conceived as a private retreat within the home of a well-travelled collector.
Bathrooms are finished in marble and stocked with Byredo products.
The minibar is replenished each day with refreshments from local artisans and producers.
The resort spa is BODHI Spa, from an Australian wellness brand.
BODHI Spa has treatment rooms and private VIP suites.
The outdoor pool sits at the heart of the resort, framed by lush greenery.
Laurus Table pairs the cuisine of Italy's Amalfi Coast with Singapore's coastal bounty.
Cocktails at The Collector's Bar feature herbs and botanicals from the Chef's Herb Garden.

highlights.text: The interiors blend Peranakan and colonial influences with tropical motifs.
The Presidential Suite has a ceiling mural by Singaporean artist Geraldine Toh.
The suites feature art made in partnership with ART:DIS, which supports artists with disabilities.
BODHI Spa offers signature treatments such as the Zerobody Dry Float and the Recovery Red Light Pod.
A Taste of Tradition is a daily, complimentary showcase of local delicacies such as Nyonya kueh in the lobby.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
